_about: The top bar and footer of every Arena page. Read by site/chrome.mjs (index.html, lookup.html), tools/hunter/board.py (board.html) and tools/check/report.py (report.html, the logo only). Every href is relative, so the pages work from any folder they are served from. "repo" is where site/build.mjs links file names (ARENA_REPO_URL / ARENA_REPO_REF override it).

mark._about: The Arena logo: an open ring and a dot. Drawn in a 100 x 100 box. The ring is the text colour, the dot the theme's broke red (--bad).

footer_note: Local sandbox results. Held means these attacks found nothing. Another attack could still break the guard.
